title: a Write, Edit, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit of a .env, .auth or settings.local.json style path counts as one secret-path read, and no path is printed
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-28). A tool call that writes a secret-looking path counts in secret_path_reads like a read: Write, Edit and MultiEdit by file_path, NotebookEdit by notebook_path. The content, old_string, new_string, edits and new_source inputs are never read, and the counter and the rule-break kind keep their names (a write is a touch).
